integrity: A standard incidence-gram identity and known original-vertex finite-field methods are acknowledged; distinct edge-space Jordan ranks, part-count parity correction, and complete depth census are the mathematical claim.
scientific_limitations: Proof covers even-sized parts of complete multipartite simple graphs and the self-exclusive binary line-graph rule; not arbitrary graphs, odd-sized parts, or self-inclusive rules. Originality is provisional against possible unindexed historical equivalents.
title: Three-step edge-parity extinction and a part-count Jordan law for even multipartite graphs
